label: EnergyOS API
info: EnergyOS GTB simulator — import this into Node-RED to enable all dashboard endpoints.

name: ping response
func: msg.payload = { ok: true, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() }; msg.statusCode = 200; return msg;

name: zones response
func: msg.payload = [{"id":"z1","name":"Bloc Opératoire 1","type":"medical","status":"active","mode":"normal","temp":21,"humidity":55,"load_kw":18.4,"priority":1,"devices":[{"id":"d1","name":"CTA Bloc Principal","protocol":"BACnet","status":"online","type":"hvac","load_rating_kw":18.4}]},{"id":"z2","name":"Bloc Opératoire 2","type":"medical","status":"active","mode":"normal","temp":20,"humidity":58,"load_kw":16.1,"priority":1,"devices":[{"id":"d5","name":"CTA Bloc Secondaire","protocol":"BACnet","status":"online","type":"hvac","load_rating_kw":16.1}]},{"id":"z3","name":"Unité de Soins Intensifs","type":"medical","status":"active","mode":"normal","temp":22,"humidity":50,"load_kw":12.7,"priority":1,"devices":[{"id":"d8","name":"Chiller Principal #1","protocol":"BACnet","status":"online","type":"hvac","load_rating_kw":120.0}]},{"id":"z4","name":"Salle de Réveil","type":"medical","status":"active","mode":"normal","temp":23,"humidity":52,"load_kw":8.2,"priority":2,"devices":[]},{"id":"z5","name":"Consultations Ext. — RDC","type":"admin","status":"active","mode":"eco","temp":25,"humidity":60,"load_kw":3.1,"priority":3,"devices":[]},{"id":"z6","name":"Administration","type":"admin","status":"inactive","mode":"off","temp":28,"humidity":65,"load_kw":0.4,"priority":4,"devices":[]},{"id":"z7","name":"Pharmacie","type":"support","status":"active","mode":"normal","temp":20,"humidity":45,"load_kw":5.6,"priority":2,"devices":[]},{"id":"z8","name":"Laboratoire","type":"support","status":"active","mode":"normal","temp":21,"humidity":50,"load_kw":7.3,"priority":2,"devices":[]},{"id":"z9","name":"Hall Principal","type":"common","status":"active","mode":"eco","temp":26,"humidity":62,"load_kw":1.8,"priority":4,"devices":[]},{"id":"z10","name":"Parking / Extérieur","type":"external","status":"active","mode":"auto","temp":null,"humidity":null,"load_kw":2.2,"priority":5,"devices":[]}]; return msg;

name: live response
func: var base = 87.3; var noise = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 8; msg.payload = { total_power_kw: parseFloat((base + noise).toFixed(1)), today_kwh: 412.6, cos_phi: 0.87, active_alerts: 2, peak_kw_today: 134.2, subscribed_kw: 260 }; return msg;

name: alerts response
func: msg.payload = [{"id":"a1","severity":"warning","zone":"Consultations Ext. — RDC","message":"Facteur de puissance cos φ = 0.71 (seuil: 0.85)","time":"14:32","acknowledged":false},{"id":"a2","severity":"info","zone":"Administration","message":"Zone inactive depuis 47 min — passage en mode Éco automatique","time":"13:55","acknowledged":true},{"id":"a3","severity":"critical","zone":"Groupe Électrogène","message":"Puissance souscrite à 89% — délestage imminent","time":"11:20","acknowledged":false},{"id":"a4","severity":"info","zone":"Parking / Extérieur","message":"Éclairage externe activé (luminosité < seuil)","time":"07:45","acknowledged":true}]; return msg;

name: config get
func: msg.payload = { eco_schedules: [], ipe_threshold: 180, alert_cos_phi: 0.85, gtb_active: true }; return msg;

name: control response
func: msg.payload = { ok: true, zoneId: msg.payload.zoneId, parameter: msg.payload.parameter, value: msg.payload.value }; return msg;

name: ack response
func: msg.payload = { ok: true, alertId: msg.req.params.alertId }; return msg;

name: reset response
func: msg.payload = { ok: true, zones_reset: 10 }; return msg;
